programme.title: Ishq Ek Gunah
programme.desc: Kareem, a successful businessman, lives a blissful life with his beautiful wife and grown-up children. But fate has a way of turning happiness into turmoil in a single moment. One tragic day, Kareem’s loyal driver sacrifices his life in a fatal accident while saving Kareem. Shaken and indebted, Kareem takes it upon himself to honor this ultimate sacrifice. He brings the driver’s grieving wife, Fatima, and their young daughter, Nasreen, into his own home. Nasreen, a strikingly beautiful yet ambitious young woman, is quickly captivated and consumed by the wealth and grandeur of Kareem’s household. Envy takes root, and she begins to plot her way into Kareem’s heart, weaving schemes to replace the harmony of his family with her own desires.

programme.title: Hostel
programme.desc: The story is about a girls' hostel where girls from different cities come to get an education. The hostel has strict rules and regulations, the credit for which goes to the warden of the hostel, Shaista Naz. Maha is also among the girls who came here with the dream of success in her eyes. She faces Sehar and her group, who are notorious for their mischiefs. These same things will have an impact on their future life.

programme.title: Rishtey Series
programme.desc: The theme of our special stories series is Relationships. Relationships without which our life is incomplete. Relationships are the asset of our life that binds us together in the rope of feelings and emotions. Relationships are the blessings of God that we do not choose by ourselves. Throughout our life, there are many colors of relationships like love, hate, friendship, feeling, trust, and every color of relationships is special. And you will see all these special colors in the series 'Rishtay' on AAN TV.

programme.title: Mera Susraal
programme.desc: It is a story of Dua who marries Nadeem Ahmed out of love and enters a household where her sisters-in-law, elder and younger, engulf their lives in the greed for wealth, poisoning the happiness of Nadeem Ahmed and Dua's joy-filled life. The elder and younger sisters always assert their dominance over Nadeem Ahmed, and he, in turn, obeys their every command. In reality, both these sisters never wanted Nadeem Ahmed to marry Dua, but Nadeem Ahmed fell in love with Dua, and they got married, dreaming of starting a new life together, which remained incomplete due to the selfishness of the sisters.

programme.title: Muqaam
programme.desc: Amber and Sehar are very close friends. Amber is a simple, homely girl, while Sehar is modern, bold, and a little selfish, driven by her love for wealth. Amber gets married to Hassan, a handsome young man who believes that an ideal life partner should be modern and bold. Although Hassan marries Amber due to his family's choice, when he meets Sehar, he sees his ideal partner in her. Hassan's admiration and constant praise for Sehar greatly please her, and she completely forgets that she is crossing boundaries with her best friend's husband. Amber's simplicity and naïve nature create the space for Hassan and Sehar to grow closer, until Hassan even decides to marry Sehar as his second wife. Will Amber and Sehar's friendship turn into hatred? By rejecting Amber's love, will Hassan openly confess his love for Sehar? When respect disappears from relationships, how can anyone find their true place?

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: "Alaskan Bush People" is a reality-documentary series that introduces the Brown family -- Billy, wife Ami and their seven grown children who -- according to Discovery -- are interesting because "they are unlike any other family in America." The channel says they are so far removed from civilization that they often go six to nine months each year without seeing an outsider. They refer to themselves as a "wolf pack" and, perhaps due to isolation, have their own accent and dialect. The Browns live in the Copper River Valley, where temperatures can drop to 60 degrees below zero, and the family recently relocated and built a cabin there because, they say, their former home of many years was seized and burned down for being in the wrong location on public land.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a stranger has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.

programme.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programme.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programme.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Dynasties II
programme.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquettes, the females of which are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty. Against the backdrop of pristine corners of the Earth - from harsh Patagonia to African savannahs - various animal families fight for survival.Parents must pass on to their offspring skills that will influence their lives.Produced on an impressive scale, the series presents the adventures of animal clans, devoting each episode to different characters.Representatives of the fauna kingdom are shown through the prism of human behavior - they fight fiercely for power, build alliances, look for partners and provide their children with a school of life.And all this takes place against the background of phenomenal landscapes from the farthest corners of the globe.In the land of meerkats This time, the filmmakers go to Botswana, where a multi-generational herd of meerkats lives in the hot and dry climate of the Makgadikgadi salt flats.The ruler, who was named Maghogho, must unite her family so that her young can survive in an extremely hostile environment.However, she lacks experience, so she works by trial and error.In moments of danger, she sometimes makes bad decisions.Fate puts many challenges before her - from problems with a gang of rivals to violent storms.There are plenty of suspenseful moments in this bittersweet story.However, the herd of little ones has a chance to survive thanks to the strong bond that unites them.

programme.title: Blue Planet 2
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary will present the underwater world.Viewers will have the opportunity to admire a hammerhead shark hunting its prey or a caran shark jumping out of the water into the air while hunting for a bird.

programme.title: Spy in the Ocean
programme.desc: The creators of the four-episode series present the journey of specially constructed animal replicas equipped with cameras to the ocean.Their goal is to bring closer the deeply hidden life of creatures inhabiting this inaccessible and dynamic ecosystem.Using breakthrough technology, including:modern LCD screens, record surprising behaviors and relationships of sea animals.Viewers will see colorful coral reefs, rocky coastlines, Thai macaques fishing, unusual behavior of seals, socialization of sperm whales and a complicated ritual between hermit crabs.The over thirty spies include a sperm whale, a herring, a puffer, a hermit crab, a clownfish and a dolphin.The production took three years on four oceans of the world Filmmakers used new technologies to present the magic of the underwater world from a previously unavailable perspective.Robots equipped with cameras - confusingly similar to sea animals - set off on a spy mission.They not only passively recorded their surroundings, but also interacted with representatives of various species.The spectacular recordings were made into a documentary series that combines a fascinating narrative with impressive photos and humor.Its characters include sperm whales, octopuses, macaques, puffers, crabs and marlins.Underwater Geniuses One of the robotic spies took the form of a baby sperm whale.Not only cameras were installed there, but also hydrophones recording sounds.The three-meter-long baby was supposed to arouse the maternal instinct of the female it encountered.It greeted him with characteristic clicks.The moving meeting scene gave insight into the social intelligence of these giants.On an isolated Thai island, a dummy monkey spied on a diving flock of macaques.Cameras recorded their clever use of tools and carefree fun.In turn, the mechanical cephalopod went to meet the coconut octopus.Their interaction showed that true geniuses live in depths inaccessible to man.

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: Antarctica is the coldest and windiest continent.The climate here is harsh, and only the toughest can survive.From Weddell seals crushing the ice with their teeth, to colorful starfish covering the seabed hidden under the ice.Penguin chicks may lose their lives when confronted by killer whales and leopard seals.Meanwhile, starfish and huge worms line the seabed as a feeding spectacle takes place on the surface.Life comes to Antarctica because the ocean surrounding the continent is extremely rich.Thousands of penguins, seals, albatrosses and over a hundred huge whales feast on the krill schools.Unfortunately, the local waters are warming, and as the temperature increases, the future of the local fauna and flora looks more and more uncertain.

programme.title: The Jetty
programme.desc: In her hometown, Detective Ember Manning (Jenna Coleman) begins to experience a series of terrifying events.The investigator tries to solve their mystery.He checks whether the death of a risk-taking journalist, a fire that broke out on a boat, and an illegal relationship with minors have anything in common.When he seeks the truth, he does not agree to compromise.This time, however, the truth may prove dangerous to her orderly life.He must look at his past differently, understand the complicated present, and see the real face of the city he considers home.

programme.title: Blue Lights 2
programme.desc: Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) are on duty in Belfast.They quickly discover that no training will prepare them for what they have to face - reality can be much more demanding and unpredictable.A year has passed since the dismantling of the McIntyre gang, but the vacuum left behind is immediately filled with new groups fighting for dominance.As tensions mount, the team is joined by Constable Shane Bradley (Frank Blake), whose intentions raise doubts among his colleagues.When a young loyalist begins to destabilize the fragile balance in the city, the police face the specter of a brutal confrontation.Their personal lives are equally turbulent.Tommy is considering going into intelligence more and more seriously, and Grace is struggling with missing her son and the feelings she begins to bond with one of the officers.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird’s eye can see into the west….

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named \"Duck Poo Fragrance\" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional \"yum cha\" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling \"kueh\" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals..

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures..

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as \"The First City along the Yangtze River.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture.\nIn this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called \"bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Our Wild Neighbors Ep.1
programme.desc: This film turns its lens to the wild animals living in our cities. It's a story about conservation that also asks a deeper question: what kind of city do we want to build, and what kind of planning and design will create a better life for people while leaving room for everyone else? Perhaps by reimagining urban development, there is a way for humans and nature to truly coexist.

programme.title: Road absurdities
programme.desc: We will see an expressway with a speed limit of 50 km/h and a micro-roundabout in Kielce.In Rzeszów, attention is drawn to the accumulation of mirrors on the main road, and in Warsaw - another intersection with a road to nowhere, although with full infrastructure.In Pawłowice there is a frame for sound-absorbing screens separating the track from the road.We will see an example of improper use of U12c bollards in Lublin, a strange roadside sign on a road without a shoulder in Łuków, and another local road in Łuków which, in addition to holes, also has a speed bump.We will also look at sharp energy-consuming barriers in Święcice, a left turn leading straight to the barrier on DK74 and a road in Wrocław that officials closed instead of repairing.

programme.title: Road absurdities
programme.desc: Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysiek Ruszała will check where the roundabout with only two access roads in Bielsko-Biała comes from.In Bieruń we will see a power pole on the road, in Tychy - an innovative bus lane, and in Gliwice - a closed street full of signs and barriers.In Warsaw's Ursynów we will find a dangerous bicycle path, in Natolin - a new roundabout that is of no use to anyone, and in Tuchola we will focus on signs obscured by roadside trees.Słupsk will surprise us with a railway crossing in the street, and Gwizd - with fancy private barriers on the access roads to the property.In Tomaszów Mazowiecki, the crew of the S201 siren will admire the abundance of signs informing about the main road and the simultaneous lack of yield signs on minor roads, and in Łódź - a sidewalk with 11 manholes within an 8-meter radius.

programme.title: Milkiyat
programme.desc: Soha, a young woman raised by her grandfather after losing her parents, lives a simple yet strong life. She is happily married to Rafay, a loving and caring husband. However, her world falls apart when Rafay dies in a tragic accident. Zaviyar is a wealthy and arrogant man who has everything in life except true love. He was once deeply in love but after being betrayed, he no longer believes in relationships and keeps his distance from emotions. Fate brings Soha and Zaviyar together, but they are unaware of their true connection at first. Zaviyar is burdened by guilt from a mistake in his past, and in an attempt to ease it, he begins helping Soha and her family. Over time, this brings him closer to her, and he gradually falls in love. Will Zaviyar get his love? Why is Soha not convinced by Zaviyar’s love? Can Zaviyar escape the guilt that follows him every step? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. programme.title: Behkaway
programme.desc: In a world where desires blur the lines between right and wrong, one man’s pursuit of happiness sets off a chain of irreversible consequences. Zubair, a middle-aged man hardened by ego and entitlement, rules over his household with an iron hand. His wife, Zeenat, bears the weight of his injustices in silence, enduring not only his coldness but the cruelty of his mother and sister. Despite her unwavering love and devotion, Zeenat receives nothing but pain in return. But everything begins to shift when Zubair encounters Sitara, a young, captivating woman whose charm ignites a dangerous spark within him. Driven by selfish desires, Zubair makes a decision that sets off a ripple effect far beyond his control. Will Zubair abandon Zeenat after meeting Sitara? Will his decision have consequences for his family? And will Sitara prove to be a blessing or a nightmare in disguise for him? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Pehli Barish
programme.desc: Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself. Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred. Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago. Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds? GEO & 7th Sky Entertainment presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Case No.9

Sehar, confident and driven, joins the company of Kamran, a domineering businessman feared by everyone for his egoistic and controlling nature. Unlike others, Sehar refuses to conform, letting her talent and integrity shine. Sehar’s defiance unsettles Kamran, who sets out to teach her a lesson. What follows is Sehar’s journey of redemption and resilience as she navigates the challenges thrown her way. Will Kamran succeed in teaching Sehar a lesson, or will she rise above his schemes? programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. Fate intervenes when Shokat’s son, Rahil, and Sami’s daughter, Alina, fall in love despite their fathers’ enmity. For the sake of their children, Sami and Shokat agree to Rahil and Alina’s marriage. However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Dolly Darling
programme.desc: Dolly is a drama queen and an extrovert; while her husband is just the opposite, an introvert. Also her obsession and endless love for husband simply drives him nuts. But then Dolly has her own quirky talents. She is a bundle of nerves, always bubbling with boundless energy and blessed with a quick mind and a razor sharp tongue. A stylish, lively, naive and innocent Dolly does everything and goes to every extent to captivate her husband, to become his sweetheart and a darling. But at the end of the day it is not meant to be so and she fails to make an impression on her husband. So she has a smart plan She intelligently influences the people around her and the individuals in her daily life to become the star she always wanted to be for her husband, the heroine; Dolly Darling.

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Dil Awaiz
programme.desc: This is a story of a young girl named Dil Awaiz who despite living in her father’s house is treated as an orphan and is deprived of love and care. Dil Awaiz’s father, Shahab Uddin is an influential and wealthy businessman who keeps his distance from his firstborn, Dil Awaiz due to her mother’s past. Things take an unexpected turn when a handsome, young man Sikandar enters Dil Awaiz’s life and once again she is expected to compromise and sacrifice herself in order to save her family’s honour and respect. Despite living like an outsider all her life will Dil Awaiz be able to make yet another sacrifice? Even after all the atrocities, will Dil Awaiz be able to gain due respect in the house?

However, Sami sets a condition: the marriage will only happen if Shokat’s daughter, Rubab, marries Sami’s son, Sikandar. Although intended to prevent the marriage, unforeseen circumstances led both families to agree, resulting in the marriages of both Rahil and Alina, as well as Rubab and Sikandar. Can Rubab and Sikandar accept each other? Will their children’s marriage end the feud between Sami and Shokat? Will Rubab and Sikandar have a joyful marriage? Will Alina and Rahil help them understand one another?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Inaam-e- Mohabbat
programme.desc: Sabeen Samiuddin Sehgal is a rich and influential businesswoman with a dominating and controlling demeanour. Sabeen along with her son, Mair and daughter, Sawera leads a comfortable life however Sabeen isn’t aware of her children’s wishes. To further strengthen her business, she wants both of her children to marry according to her own will. On the other hand, Anaya is a young, self-reliant girl who hails from a lower-middle-class family. Anaya’s father has been working as a driver for Sabeen’s household for the past fifteen years. Unaware of Anaya’s family background, Mair falls in love with her however things take an unfortunate turn when Sabeen finds out about their love affair. In efforts to separate Mair and Anaya, Sabeen continues to disturb Anaya and her family. In an effort to destroy Anaya’s life, Sabeen is able to create multiple misunderstandings that eventually take a toll on Mair’s life as well. After facing several troubles and humiliation at the hands of Sabeen, will Anaya stand up for herself? Will Mair be able to realize his mother’s true intentions and defend his love for Anaya?

programme.title: Dolly Darling
programme.desc: Dolly is a drama queen and an extrovert; while her husband is just the opposite, an introvert. Also her obsession and endless love for husband simply drives him nuts. But then Dolly has her own quirky talents. She is a bundle of nerves, always bubbling with boundless energy and blessed with a quick mind and a razor sharp tongue. A stylish, lively, naive and innocent Dolly does everything and goes to every extent to captivate her husband, to become his sweetheart and a darling. But at the end of the day it is not meant to be so and she fails to make an impression on her husband. So she has a smart plan She intelligently influences the people around her and the individuals in her daily life to become the star she always wanted to be for her husband, the heroine; Dolly Darling.

programme.title: Chaal
programme.desc: Shokat and Sami are best friends, and Shokat is in love with Sabeen, Sami’s sister. However, due to the schemes of a fellow student Shaista, Shokat begins to mistrust Sabeen and leaves her to marry Shaista. Feeling betrayed, Shokat ends his friendship with Sami, turning them into enemies. Years later, Shokat and Sami are successful industrialists who still don’t see eye to eye. programme.title: Qalandar
programme.desc: Qalandar is a story of a girl’s firm belief in her God and His decisions while the rest of the world continues to hurt, defame and challenge her. Dur-e-Adan is a young and innocent girl who has grown up under the care of her uncle and aunt. Despite being an orphan at an early age, Dur-e-Adan doesn’t complain about her challenges and difficulties. On the contrary, Tabriz is a handsome young man who aspires to achieve great things in life. Living in the same locality, Tabriz’s parents find Dur-e-Adan suitable for him as a life partner. However, Tabriz’s life takes a surprising turn when Sumbul hailing from a wealthy family falls in love with him. In efforts to secure his future financially, Tabriz forgets the gift that he has been bestowed in the form of Dur-e-Adan for this world and hereafter. Soon, Tabriz’s half-heartedness and conflicting loyalties in the form of greed begins to reflect in his relationship with Dur-e-Adan. Amidst all the atrocities faced by Dur-e-Adan will she continue to be patient with those around her? Will Tabriz realize the respect and love that Dur-e-Adan deserves or will he continue to hurt her? Will Tabriz be able to mend his relationship with Dur-e-Adan?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Ghulam Bashah Sundri
programme.desc: Set in a world where emotions run deep and power defines fate, Ghulam Bashah Sundri is a gripping drama of love, rivalry, and control. As relationships are tested and loyalties begin to fracture, desire turns into conflict and hearts become battlegrounds. At the center lies a compelling love triangle that draws each character into an intense emotional, social, and personal reckoning, where every choice carries consequences.

programme.title: Maa
programme.desc: Maa is an emotional family drama about love, loss, and identity. The story follows Raaha, a lively young girl raised by her grandfather, unaware of the painful truth about her birth. Abandoned by her mother Tara to protect her, and separated from her parents due to class differences and betrayal. Will Raaha uncover the truth about her past and find the love she was denied?

programme.title: Humnava
programme.desc: Humnava is more than just a drama it’s an emotional journey through love betrayal and resilience. It tells the story of a woman whose world is shaken when the one she trusted the most breaks her heart. But this is not just her story it reflects the pain of every person who’s ever been torn between loyalty and heartbreak. As relationships are tested and conspiracies unfold Humnava shows how real love doesn’t fade it fights it survives and it rises. Through shattered trust emotional trials and inner strength this drama is a reminder that in the end truth and sincerity always win.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programme.title: Den sidste viking
programme.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Do miasteczka Nightmute przyjeżdża policjant Will Dormer (Al Pacino) wraz ze swoim partnerem Hapem Eckhartem (Martin Donovan).Mężczyźni mają odnaleźć sprawcę zabójstwa siedemnastoletniej dziewczyny.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.Trop prowadzi do pisarza Waltera Fincha (Robin Williams), który przyjaźnił się z ofiarą.Podczas pościgu za nim w gęstej mgle Will strzela do partnera.Hap dies.W ostatnich słowach oskarża Willa, że zrobił to, by uniemożliwić wewnętrzne śledztwo.Dormer zaciera ślady, kierując podejrzenia na Fincha.Pisarz, który był świadkiem zabójstwa Hapa, zaczyna szantażować Willa.Tymczasem miejscowa policjantka, Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank), jest coraz bliżej odkrycia prawdy o śmierci Hapa.

programme.title: 28 Days Later...
programme.desc: W jednym z laboratoriów w Wielkiej Brytanii został wyhodowany zabójczy wirus.Grupa obrońców zwierząt wdziera się tam i uwalnia małpy, na których prowadzono badania.Oszalałe z wściekłości zwierzęta rzucają się na swoich wybawców.Zainfekowana osoba w ciągu 12 sekund traci panowanie nad sobą i staje się żądną krwi bestią.Epidemia niezwykle szybko rozprzestrzenia się na cały kraj.28 dni później leżący na oddziale intensywnej terapii w jednym z londyńskich szpitali Jim (Cillian Murphy) budzi się ze śpiączki.Nie rozumiejąc, co się stało, błąka się po opustoszałych ulicach miasta.Przerażonego mężczyznę atakują gromady rozwścieczonych ludzi.Z opresji ratują go Selena (Naomie Harris) i Mark (Noah Huntley).Wszyscy troje uciekają z miasta i trafiają do bazy wojskowej dowodzonej przez majora Henry'ego Westa (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programme.title: Ghostlight
programme.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.W jego życiu zachodzą zmiany.

programme.title: Robot Dreams
programme.desc: A lonely and timid Dog lives in colorful, bustling New York.Nieufny barykaduje się w swoim mieszkaniu i z żalem patrzy na gwarne miasto.The cure for his fears turns out to be a Robot, which the pet orders under the influence of an advertisement.When the parcel arrives, the dog assembles the sent model.Ten ożywa i od razu staje się najlepszym kumplem psa.From then on, the friends spend fun-filled days together.Chodzą na wrotki, jedzą hot-dogi, słuchają muzyki i spacerują ulicami metropolii.They are inseparable.However, their happy life together ends with a trip to the beach.Bathing in the sea has a tragic ending for Robot - he cannot move and has to stay in a sandy, closed area.Zrozpaczony Pies nie jest w stanie sam go przenieść.Robi jednak wszystko, by go stamtąd wyciągnąć.Once again he must overcome his fear of the world.His immobilized friend also dreams of the day when they will finally meet again.An Oscar-nominated animation based on a comic book by Sara Varon.

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with a progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Hal Porterfield (Christopher Abbott) orders room service at a posh hotel.Rebecca Marin (Margaret Qualley) shows up at the apartment to interview him for the position of general manager of this chain of facilities.Her questions become more and more personal and lead to a surprising ending.In reality, the woman is a dominatrix who follows the script prepared by Hal.However, the relationship does not follow the script ordered by the client.The woman decides to blackmail the rich man.She claims that she recorded a compromising sex tape with him.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: Lucy (Dakota Johnson), an employee of a luxury dating agency, measures her professional success by having nine arranged marriages.Together with her colleagues, she recruits clients based on their market value, which is determined by financial status, education and age.She follows a similar logic herself.She ended her five-year relationship because her boyfriend John (Chris Evans) had too little income.Now she is single and waiting for a rich man whom she will quickly marry.Fate sends her Harry (Pedro Pascal), the owner of an apartment worth... 12 million dollars.A relationship with him, even without love, becomes a beneficial investment for her and a guarantee of a high standard of living.But then John appears on the horizon again and, against her better judgment, Lucy begins to have doubts...

programme.title: Manodrome
programme.desc: Ralphie (Jesse Eisenberg) recently lost his job.He barely makes ends meet by moonlighting as an Uber driver, while his partner Sal (Odessa Young) is about to give birth.Ralphie is not prepared for his new role, and his problems make it difficult for him to control his emotions.Seeing his helplessness and growing frustration, his gym friend Jason introduces him to the charismatic Dan (Adrien Brody), the leader of a mysterious group of celibate men who preach patriarchy.Ralphie, in crisis, is drawn into their world.Over time, he develops a dangerous obsession.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Police officers Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs are assigned to a dangerous mission.They are busting a gang of drug smugglers, led by a man named Montoya.The trafficker is believed to be involved in the murder of two federal agents and the family of their informant.Crockett and Tubbs infiltrate the Montoi organization.Sonny begins an affair with Isabella, who invests the proceeds of crime in legal ventures.Crockett tries to protect his lover, having no idea what the woman actually does and what her true identity is.Meanwhile, Tubbs and his girlfriend, analyst Trudy Joplin, try to understand the activities of criminals using their own methods.Ricardo does not know that he is putting his beloved in danger.Wanting to reach the gang leader, two detectives decide to transport a load of drugs to southern Florida.Gradually, the lines between the rules of the underworld and the rule of law are blurring.

programme.title: 28 weeks later
programme.desc: The virus spreading throughout Great Britain, which triggered murderous instincts in people, devastated the entire country.28 weeks later, the authorities decide to repopulate the deserted areas.Settlers are brought to a closely guarded part of London.Among them are Don Harris (Robert Carlyle) and his teenage children, Andy (Mackintosh Muggleton) and Tammy (Imogen Poots).The siblings sneak out at night to a destroyed part of the city.They find their mother (Catherine McCormack) there and decide to bring her to the base.

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programme.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programme.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the affair will turn into a lasting relationship.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: Gli addestratori
programme.desc: A somewhat clumsy but passionate dog trainer, Pasquale Marolla (Pasquale Petrolo), dreams of opening his own training center for dogs.Unfortunately, he loses the competition and a bet with his ex-wife, Marta (Geppi Cucciari), which causes the woman to take away his beloved pet, the border collie Cecchino.To get money and prove to the woman that he is enterprising, the man advertises a summer course for dogs.He is very surprised when he discovers that, as a result of a mistake, instead of pets, several children come to him.At first he can't cope with them, but then he comes up with a clever idea.Over time, the entire group begins to form an extraordinary bond, and through laughter and shared challenges, both Pasquale and the children learn true values: friendship, respect and sensitivity.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that people are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

programme.title: River Wild
programme.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Li Fong's friend needs help.He decided to take part in a karate tournament, but his skills are insufficient.Teacher Han turns to the legendary Daniel LaRusso for help.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean grew up in a broken home.He never planned to build a lasting relationship until he met Cindy, with whom he fell in love at first sight.When, after a few weeks of dating, it turns out that the girl is expecting another man's child, she makes the difficult decision to get married.The couple tries to create a happy family, but over time they begin to face a serious crisis.The infatuation disappears, and everyday problems make it difficult for them to find understanding.Dean abuses alcohol and does simple physical work, unable to guarantee his wife real stability and support.The couple falls into conflicts more and more often.However, he still tries to rebuild his relationships for the sake of little Frankie.This perfectly portrayed study of the breakdown of a relationship was nominated for the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival.The role of Michelle Williams was nominated for an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Blink Twice
programme.desc: At a charity event, waitress Frida (Naomi Ackie) meets billionaire tech mogul Slater King (Channing Tatum).Together with her friend Jess (Alia Shawkat), she accepts his invitation to a private island.On site are Slater's friends and business partners: photographer Vic (Christian Slater), private chef Cody (Simon Rex), DJ Tom (Haley Joel Osment), college graduate Lucas (Levon Hawke), reality star Sarah (Adria Arjona), aspiring app creator Camilla (Liz Caribel) and lawyer Heather (Trew Mullen).A holiday stay means crazy nights interspersed with sunny days.All the guests are having a great time.Until then.Mysterious events occur that make Frida grow anxious.She will have to find the truth to save her life.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: The year is 2154. Los Angeles resembles a landfill.People are struggling to survive on a devastated Earth, full of violence and poverty.Rich people live on the Elysium space station.Among the technologies available to them are medical capsules that cure diseases.One day, Max Da Costa, who lives in the slums, is heavily irradiated as a result of an accident at a factory.The dose is lethal.He has five days left.He realizes that only the capsule can save him.So he visits the smuggler Spider, hoping that thanks to him he will get to Elysium.The man promises help on the condition that he will kidnap the wealthy Carlyle for him.The dying Da Costa's body is enhanced with new technology.He soon comes into possession of secret information that could destroy the current order.

programme.title: Laws of Man
programme.desc: A suspenseful story set in the paranoid climate of the Cold War era.The year is 1963. Two federal marshals are investigating a case in rural Nevada.They are on the trail of a sinister conspiracy.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is an ambitious investigative journalist who, thanks to his determination, always achieves his goal.However, when one of his missions - exposing the unethical activities of the Life Foundation - turns into an obsession, Eddie loses his job and breaks up with his fiancée Anne (Michelle Williams).Weakened, he accidentally enters into a symbiosis with an alien - the fruit of the experiments of the company owner, the sinister millionaire Calton Drake (Riz Ahmed).The journalist and the alien together create a powerful and bloodthirsty monster.Eddie must find a way out of the situation before a dangerous monster takes him completely over.Meanwhile, Drake follows the reporter's trail and wants to get his property back.The comic Venom was created years ago by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane.

programme.desc: After the death of her husband Gerry (Gerard Butler), Holly (Hilary Swank) falls into a deep depression.On her 30th birthday, a woman receives a mysterious parcel.The cake comes with a tape with a recorded message from... Gerry.He encourages his beloved to go out and have fun with friends.After this event, new letters regularly arrived to the young widow, each ending with a declaration of love.Gerry knew how much his wife would suffer from losing him.In letters written before her death, he encourages her to take on various challenges.Thanks to her extraordinary sense of connection with the deceased, a woman in despair undergoes specific therapy and tries to start her life anew.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Li Fong's friend needs help.He decided to take part in a karate tournament, but his skills are insufficient.Teacher Han turns to the legendary Daniel LaRusso for help.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Rémi did not recover from the breakup.In order to function, he remains in a relationship with the doll Audrey, with whom he lives and shares everyday affairs.One day, a new colleague shows up at his company.

programme.title: Veep 7
programme.desc: Preparations for the elections for the President of the United States are underway.Selina is determined to win it.The most dangerous rival turns out to be his former colleague, Jonah.

programme.title: Veep 7
